title: The Disappearance of the Yuba County Five
summary: Josh and Chuck discuss the 1978 disappearance of five friends from Yuba City, California, often called the Yuba County Five or the Gary Matthias disappearance. The men, who attended a vocational rehabilitation program and were known as "the boys," left after a Cal State Chico basketball game on February 24, 1978, and were never seen alive again. Their abandoned 1969 Mercury Montego was found up a snowbound mountain road in the Sierras. Ted Weir was found in June 1978 dead in an emergency Forest Service trailer, and the others' remains were found along the road. Gary Matthias was never found. The episode covers the odd clues: a fully stocked emergency trailer that went unused, a heart attack survivor named Joseph Shoans who saw groups of people at the snow line, a psychic tip, and open questions about why they went up the mountain. The episode ends with a listener mail segment about dental dams and protection for women who have sex with women.

segments.title: Opening banter
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck chat about travel to Denver, a Red Rocks concert, and baseball stadiums before introducing the disappearance story.

segments.title: The five friends and their lives
segments.summary: The hosts introduce the five friends from the Yuba City vocational rehabilitation center, their disabilities and diagnoses, their home-centered routines, and their basketball team.

segments.title: February 24, 1978 and the abandoned Montego
segments.summary: The night of the Cal State Chico game, the store stop, and the expected return home. The Montego is found abandoned up a mountain road days later with unusual details: a quarter tank of gas, undamaged underside, and food wrappers.

segments.title: Search and the frozen trailer
segments.summary: A snowstorm hampers searches. In June, bikers find Ted Weir dead in a Forest Service trailer, tucked in with sheets, wearing another man's watch, having lost weight and grown a long beard, with a fully stocked emergency trailer left unused.

segments.title: Joseph Shoans and the night on the mountain
segments.summary: Joseph Shoans, stuck at the snow line with a mild heart attack, reports hearing two groups of people with lights and whistling that night before walking eight miles for help. He later sees the abandoned Montego and connects it to the missing men.

segments.title: Remains found and Gary Matthias missing
segments.summary: Searchers find Madruga and Sterling along the road, then Hewitt's remains, including his father's discovery. Gary Matthias is never found. His medication, schizophrenia history, and missing tennis shoes in the trailer are discussed.

segments.title: Clues, theories, and open questions
segments.summary: The hosts review clues including a snow cat track, a water witcher's lead, a disposable lighter, a psychic tip about a red house in Oroville, and Lance Ayers' search. They weigh theories about why the men went up the mountain and why they did not use the food or fire, and conclude the simplest explanation may be getting lost.

segments.title: Closing remarks on the victims
segments.summary: The hosts reflect on the friends' lives, and invite listener theories and email.

segments.title: Listener mail on dental dams
segments.summary: A listener named Emily shares information on protection during sex between women, including dental dams and DIY alternatives from condoms or gloves.
